description: The pie chart visually represents the distribution of ten distinct relational association categories evaluated in the MMRA benchmark for large visual language models, with each slice corresponding to a specific relation type and its associated count and percentage of the total. The largest segment, labeled “ObservationAngle,” is colored teal and accounts for 126 instances (12.28%), followed by “SimilarMaterial” in orange (106, 10.33%) and “SubEvent” in red (100, 9.74%). Several categories — “UsageSimilarity” (100, 9.65%), “Environment” (90, 8.77%), “Layout” (90, 8.77%), “AppearanceSimilarity” (90, 8.77%), and “SimilarEvent” (90, 8.77%) — are nearly equal in size, each occupying approximately 8.77% of the chart and rendered in distinct shades of green, yellow, light green, and blue respectively. Smaller segments include “MentalitySimilarity” (89, 8.67%) in light cyan, “RelativePosition” (81, 7.90%) in gray, and “NearSameEntity” (63, 6.34%) in dark gray. Each slice is labeled with its category name, count, and percentage, and the chart uses a consistent color-coding scheme with no exploded or emphasized segments, presenting a clear, proportional breakdown of relational association types assessed in the benchmark.
